caption: The drawing depicts a small, squarish building with the word "BANK" written in red capital letters on its pale, off-white front wall. The building has four visible windows, two on the front and two on the side, each outlined in red. The front facade includes a set of steps, in shades of blue and gray, leading up to a white double door with three vertical black rectangles representing panels or glass inserts. The structure sits on a red brick foundation depicted by rectangular patterns. The side of the building features a tall, narrow window with a lattice pattern. The building is topped with a large brownish roof that extends outward and a smaller, centrally positioned cupola, colored in a similar hue with a blue cap and a small golden knob on top. The bank is depicted against a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Penny Bank
